propositions: A new plan-review criterion ac-process-gate must be added to CANONICAL_LLM to flag acceptance criteria that are generic mechanical process gates (tests pass, CI green, children closed) rather than ticket-specific deliverables.
The ac-process-gate criterion must execute in 1-TURN mode, be non-code-grounded, and ship as advisory posture with documented promotion path via criteria_routing.json for operator dogfood gating.

The criterion must discriminate via the litmus: would this AC read identically on an arbitrary unrelated ticket (generic gate → fire) versus does it name this ticket's specific deliverable (pass), with err-toward-silence anti-false-positive stance.
The routing entry, prompt rubric, eval spec with ≥2 fire and ≥2 no-fire cases, and deterministic unit tests must all be implemented following the established R1/R3/R4 pattern with no new machinery.
The regenerated criteria-guide section and bounded-sanity eval artifact must be committed, and a registry packing bug (singleton trailing chunks) must be fixed to maintain facet adjacency.
